Use case: identity-preserve.
IMAGE1 is EDIT TARGET: newly drawn correct five-card character sprite. Repaint ONE independent animation pose cast/E/10. Preserve its exact head/face pixel sizes, costume/prop scales, square-canvas registration and PURE screen-RIGHT camera. Image2 portrait is authoritative identity, Image3 E idle camera, Image4 approved bright clean rounded Taoist chibi painting. No mirroring.
Camera-near anatomical RIGHT hand holds unchanged EXACTLY FIVE rectangular red talisman cards with gold flame motifs: one center panel and two each side, five distinct tops, no extra edge sliver or sixth panel. Camera-far anatomical LEFT hand grips bronze bell/red tassel, behind torso to SCREEN LEFT. Exactly TWO arms, TWO shoulders, TWO sleeve openings, TWO hands. Each sleeve continuously connects shoulder to wrist and hand, absolutely no extra cuff or empty sleeve at waist/chest. Both grips readable.
NEW POSE: Just after release peak: preserve target's three-quarter-open FRONT torso and RIGHT profile face, never turn the back to camera. Near RIGHT arm remains mostly extended RIGHT, elbow15degrees bent, unchanged FIVE-card fan lowered1% canvas and drawn inward2%. Far LEFT bell handle behind screen-left shoulder lowered2% and bell mouth angled down, exactly two continuous sleeves. Feet stay stable released stagger, knees loosen slightly, mouth begins closing. Same exact head and face pixels as target.
Maintain chestnut high ponytail, red jewel gold crown, short red/gold flame robe, black pants, yin-yang waist ornament and red-black-gold shoes. Fixed virtual root x512/ground y920 at1024; preserve target whole-canvas composition and exact body-part pixel scales. Natural small posture-driven bob only, no zoom, bbox auto-fit, resizing or lowest-pixel alignment. Full transparent margins, no clipping.
Single native square frame at least1024, true transparent RGBA. No ground, baked shadow, background, labels, effects, aura, detached flame or particles. Not a sheet.
